title: OpenMoji outline engraving masks
changes: Simple monochrome authored line art without color/shading contours. Grinning mouths have one outline without teeth dividers; skull jaw closed and tooth bars removed; sunglasses bridge simplified; flame uses one closed silhouette with a smooth rounded base. Flags and artwork without line art retain monochrome contour/knockout masks. Filled CNC variants use solid silhouettes and identifying cutouts; flag colors become contrasting monochrome regions. Skin-shadow layers omitted.
